purpose: Demo sales analytics database for natural-language-to-SQL testing.
businessRules: Revenue is calculated from order_items as quantity * unit_price - discount_amount.
Use orders.order_date as the sale date unless the user specifically asks about payment or shipment timing.
Cancelled orders should be excluded from revenue metrics unless the user explicitly asks to include them.
An unpaid order is an order whose total payments are less than its order item revenue.
Late shipment examples can be approximated as delivered more than 7 days after shipped_date.

columns.name: region_name
columns.description: Internal sales region name, such as Northeast or West.

tables.name: dbo.sales_reps
tables.description: Employees responsible for selling to customers.

columns.name: sales_rep_name
columns.description: Full name of the sales representative.

columns.name: region_id
columns.description: Region assigned to the sales representative.

columns.name: hire_date
columns.description: Date the sales representative joined the company.

columns.name: customer_name
columns.description: Legal or display name of the customer.

columns.name: customer_segment
columns.description: Commercial segment: SMB, Mid-Market, or Enterprise.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the customer account was created.

columns.name: category_name
columns.description: Category name, such as Analytics Software or Support Plans.

tables.name: dbo.products
tables.description: Products and services that can be sold.

columns.name: standard_cost
columns.description: Estimated cost used for margin calculations.

columns.name: is_discontinued
columns.description: Whether the product is no longer sold.

tables.name: dbo.orders
tables.description: Sales order header table. One row per order.

columns.name: sales_rep_id
columns.description: Sales representative credited for the order.

columns.name: order_date
columns.description: Date the order was placed. Use this for sales date metrics.

columns.name: status
columns.description: Order status, such as Open, Closed, or Cancelled.

tables.name: dbo.order_items
tables.description: Line items for each sales order.

columns.name: discount_amount
columns.description: Total discount amount applied to this line.

derivedMetrics.name: line_revenue
derivedMetrics.description: Net revenue for the order line.

derivedMetrics.name: line_margin
derivedMetrics.description: Approximate gross margin for the order line.

columns.name: payment_method
columns.description: Payment method, such as Wire, ACH, or Credit Card.

columns.name: payment_status
columns.description: Payment status, such as Paid, Partial, or Unpaid.

tables.name: dbo.shipments
tables.description: Shipment status and delivery information for orders.

columns.name: shipped_date
columns.description: Date the shipment left the warehouse.

columns.name: shipment_status
columns.description: Shipment status, such as Pending, In Transit, or Delivered.

queryGuidance: Use SELECT TOP 100 unless the user asks for aggregate-only results.
Use CAST or CONVERT only when needed for date grouping or formatting.
Return SQL Server compatible T-SQL only.
Never generate INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, MERGE, DROP, ALTER, CREATE, EXEC, xp_*, sp_*, OPENROWSET, or OPENQUERY statements.
